name: Meszlen (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Meszlen: a blue shield with a yellow lion, with a helm, a lion crest and red, yellow and grey mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Meszlen arms with helm, crest and mantling
